overall_goal: Gather vegetables and measure the rocket salad.

goals.description: Gather salad ingredients from the refrigerator.
goals.rationale: The person retrieves various vegetables and salad seeds from the refrigerator and moves them to the kitchen counter.

goals.description: Measure the rocket salad using a kitchen scale.
goals.rationale: The person prepares a bowl on a scale, adjusts it, and scoops rocket salad into the bowl to measure the correct amount.
